impact.text: Users attempting legitimate FOK trades with sizes that are not lot-aligned will always revert, blocking an advertised order type.

precondition_sources.text: The caller posts a FOK buy order whose baseAmount is 1.005 × lotSize, which is not an exact multiple of lotSize.
Internal rounding floor(amount / lotSize) * lotSize leaves a 0.005 × lotSize dust remainder greater than zero.

intent_sources.text: For a FOK buy of 1.005 × lotSize, the order should fill the 1×lot and ignore the dust, returning success with dust unfilled.
FOK orders whose sizes are not lot-aligned should not revert solely due to a positive dust remainder.
